content.short: NFTfi is the marketplace for NFT collateralized loans.
content.description: NFTfi unlocks the financialization of NFTs and digital currencies by creating a market for NFT-collateralized loans. Through this platform, borrowers can pledge their NFTs as collateral to access liquidity. The ecosystem encompasses NFT fractionalization, NFT renting, NFT derivatives, and lending or borrowing NFTs. Lenders have the flexibility to propose a wide range of loan offers, with terms adjustable according to whether the loan is intended for friendliness, acquisition, or profit.
